question:

Benchmark knowledge evidence: COUNT(raceID) > 0 reveals that this driver participated in races; drivers who finished the race refers to time has value.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.XCL_075)
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
JOIN seasons s ON ra.XCL_066 = s.XCL_091
JOIN circuits c ON ra.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
WHERE s.XCL_091 = 2008
  AND c.XCL_003 = 'China'
  AND r.XCL_080 IS NOT NULL
